structure.unit: Other Commodity-Related Boards, Councils, and Foundations

law.catch_line: Aquaculture Advisory Board membership terms; compensation

text.section: The terms for appointments to the Aquaculture Advisory Board shall be for four years. Appointments to fill vacancies shall be for the unexpired term.
Members of the Aquaculture Advisory Board shall receive no compensation for their services but shall receive reimbursement for actual expenses.
